name: Wasting Time
overview: Scripture warns against wasting time through slothfulness and calls believers to wisdom by valuing the brevity of life. The psalmist urges us to number our days so that we may gain a heart of wisdom, while Proverbs repeatedly admonishes the sluggard to rise and learn from the diligent ant. Observing the consequences of laziness, such as unproductive fields and idle rest, reminds us that there is a proper season and purpose for every action under heaven, encouraging purposeful stewardship of the time God has given.
